findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed coffee-bar sanitizer bucket to contain less than 100 PPM of Quat sanitizer. Discussed with PIC. PIC refilled bucket with new sanitizer measuring 200 PPM. Ensure concentration is tested regularly to prevent contamination of food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(B) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (B) An iodine solution shall have a: (1) Minimum temperature of 20°C (68°F), (2) PH of 5.0 or less or a PH no higher than the level for which the manufacturer specifies the solution is effective, and (3) Concentration between 12.5 MG/L and 25 MG/L.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: REPEAT-Inspector observed the cabinets under the coffee bar to be in a state of disrepair. Discussed with PIC. The particle board has swollen, cracked, and allowed the coating to peel away in some parts of the cabinet. Ensure these cabinets are replaced to render them smooth and easily cleanable. Due to violation being a repeat, a letter will be sent to the facility and facility owner.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-202.12: Inspector observed handwashing sink in women’s bathroom to not be dispensing hot water. Inspector and PIC ran the water for several minutes and water never increased in temperature. Discussed the importance of having hot water for proper handwashing. Ensure that all handwashing sinks have a temperature that reaches at least 100F. The inspector will follow up on 11/15/2024 to ensure repairs have been made.

(A) HANDWASHING SINK shall be equipped to provide water of a temperature at least 100F through mixing valve. Pf

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:

(C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.comment:

Recommend replacing the cabinets below the coffee bar by next routine inspection.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

Neither staff member present has a food handler card available for inspector review. See that staff have food handler cards on hand by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. 
Staff are using a chlorine bleach spray bottle and cloth rags for general cleaning of surfaces in the food service area. Discussed with PIC. See that disposable paper towels are used when utilizing spray cleaners/sanitizers. Cloth rags are to be used only with a sanitizer bucket, where the cloth can be held between uses in sanitizer solution.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

Norovirus cleanup policy not available during visit. See that staff are able to provide a cleanup policy by follow up date.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.

Staff unable to provide employee reporting agreements to inspector during visit. See that employee reporting agreements are signed by all staff members by follow up date.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

Neither employee present has a certified food manager's card. See that a CFM is present during all hours of operation and enough staff are certified to cover shift changes.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

During hours of food preparation/operation a CFM must be present. Ensure enough staff have obtained certificate to adequately cover hours, staff vacations/sick days/ etc.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11  (Pf) Food employee was cleaning dirty dishes at hand washing sink. Hand washing sink must be used for handwashing only. Reference 5-205.11.

Mid-inspection, observed employee draining and cleaning coffee makers in handwash sink. Ensure staff is properly trained on uses/restriction of hand sink. All other washing/dumping/etc. must occur in sinks not designated as handwashing. Inspector provided education with staff present at facility.
